player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id}. Wo reko Battleship game.
Wo botae ne sɛ wo bɛsɛn wo pɛnii nyinaa ɛberɛ a wɔn bɛsɛn wo deɛ.
Wo berɛ mu no, wo tumi bɔ missiles wɔ coordinates ahodoɔ aseɛ a wɔde format yi '[a4]'. Sɛ missile no kɔtra ship bi a, wɔde 'X' akyerɛ. Sɛ ɛkɔtra a, wɔde 'O' akyerɛ. Wɔdeɛ scenario biara mu no, game no bɛka wo hit ahodoɔ. Sɛ wo asɛn prɛko bi a, game no bɛka wo!
Game no bɛba awieɛ sɛ wo pɛnii nyinaa asɛn.
Wo board a edi kan no bɛkyerɛ wo pɛnii nyinaa a wo de guu mu ne wo pɛnii a wɔn kɔtra wo so, ne wo hit ahodoɔ ne wo miss ahodoɔ wɔ wo pɛnii so a wɔn deɛ wɔn pɛnii nkyerɛ.
Board a edi kan no ni:
